scope.human: complete native body; kinematic IK supplied by NativeMotion
scope.grasp: real palm-surface threshold, finite-force assisted rigid constraint; no independent finger friction claim
scope.bottles: dynamic finite cylinders; contacts and actual transport measured
scope.bread: visible ellipsoid; conservative box collision hull; measured mouth approach and visual bite
scope.inventory: logical ownership belongs to LifeSimulation; bag storage explicitly kinematic
scope.interruption: released objects remain at actual positions; staged owned bottles retain ownership; dropped unsold bread needs recovery

render.scope: managed native-render submissions; earlier startup GPU commands are drained before the first managed draw
render.measurement: native render submission through actual GPU fence completion; includes CPU submission and compilation
